originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: All five retain Action/V,S,F,rank8,base21RP,minimum class level15. Antilife Shell is Cleric/Druid/Wizard; the other four are Cleric/Druid/Mage/Wizard. Antimagic and Mind Blank have multiple actual school placements.
originalQuestions.options: A: retain exact native access/casting and complete only unresolved source-local interfaces. B: explicitly justify a narrow source correction without discarding its original evidence.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer A. Never union school benefits or grant extra class modes from a duplicate placement. Antimagic Core ranges are20feet Abjuration and10feet Universal; Shell10feet; others120feet. Keep actual ability/DC, repertoire, concentration transitions, final prices/cadence and cast-time counters. Core Instantaneous is not sufficient lifetime for a persistent ward and does not justify permanence.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Target immune to EFFECTS BASED ON ALIGNMENT for24hours. No willing-only requirement, save or concentration is printed.
originalQuestions.options: A: one willing perceived creature, no save or concentration,86400elapsed seconds. B: permit unwilling application with an explicitly selected save/admission rule.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose recipient admission explicitly because immunity might prevent a beneficial alignment effect too. Preserve the full24hours and current life/identity rules. Clarify death/return without inventing a resurrection exception. No automatic reveal, change or erasure of the target’s alignment, faith, reputation or oath occurs.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Alignment-based effects could mean effects gated by target alignment, payloads changing alignment, or every effect of an aligned source; these are not equivalent.
originalQuestions.options: A: block only recipient components whose mechanical eligibility or outcome actually depends on alignment. B: also protect against alignment-changing components. C: protect against everything emitted by an aligned actor.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose a complete narrow predicate, not a name/tag guess. Explicitly resolve effective-axis reads versus mutations, alignment detection/forecast, Alignment Suggestion/Purge, Lock/Anchor, damage whose amount depends on alignment, and a ward’s entry check. C would swallow ordinary attacks by almost every aligned creature and needs exceptional justification. Preserve all printed protection; do not reduce it to one arbitrarily named condition. Alignment-based benefits and voluntary bypass require their own exact decision.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Accepted AC4-ALIGN-01 keeps underlying records and applies Lock/Anchor snapshots last; source-specific undefined-axis treatment already differs among spells.
originalQuestions.options: A: immunity intercepts only its selected eligible applications or expressions, retaining underlying identity/history. B: additionally remove or suppress named preexisting effects under a new explicit rule.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify initial prevention versus protection against preexisting live components. Do not cancel history, turn unknown axes Neutral, suppress ordinary alignment records, create a ratchet baseline, or refund spent costs. Use each actual source’s effective/canonical/snapshot predicate. Leaving suppression or expiry cannot replay a prevented cast, renew a lower deadline or create retrospective alignment changes.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: An immunity can conflict with source-specific admission rules without becoming unrestricted passage or an information oracle.
originalQuestions.options: A: decide component-by-component immunity with exact scope for existing alignment wards and queries. B: universal bypass of every alignment-related object and place.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer A but state its real results: if an alignment-based barrier cannot exclude this bearer, whether physical entry becomes permitted must be explicit, not left as a hidden contradiction. Other physical/planar/ownership restrictions stay real. Preventing a query must not invent a false alignment or expose the warded recipient’s secret exact state. Mechanical suppression/removal of this immunity remains separate from immunity to an alignment-based spell.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: 10-foot BARRIER keeps LIVING CREATURES at bay; Core range10feet,concentration up to1minute supplies no shape, radius, center or following rule.
originalQuestions.options: A: explicitly select a finite sphere/shell and whether it is fixed or follows a real bearer. B: a specified wall or other finite barrier matching the printed10feet.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose geometry and placement at commitment, including radius-versus-diameter, thickness, complete occupied-body boundary and line of effect. Define initial occupants and overlapping bodies without free forced placement, crushing or deletion. If it follows the caster, resolve movement into creatures and moving support; no unprinted sweeping push, automatic cancellation or infinite trapped overlap should be assumed.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Living is not simply HP above0, Humanoid, non-Undead, or non-summoned. Accepted life/body sources distinguish real living creatures, Undead, Constructs, generated bodies and transformation identity.
originalQuestions.options: A: use explicitly established native living-state classification at each relevant admission check. B: list a source-local complete type predicate with justified exceptions.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select the actual predicate and treatment of unresolved profiles without inventing ontology. Include unconscious0HP living creatures, corpses, Undead, living plant/animal bodies, constructs with actual exceptional life tags, generated summons and identity-preserving forms. Determine where a carried living creature’s own body is checked rather than inheriting its carrier’s classification. The caster cannot be excluded accidentally without an expressly chosen self rule.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Keeping living creatures at bay states exclusion, not blanket immunity to attacks or passage by nonliving matter.
originalQuestions.options: A: block selected boundary-crossing of living bodies, leaving other channels subject to their ordinary rules. B: a broader explicitly authored physical/effect barrier.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Decide voluntary and forced crossing, carriage, teleport destination, partial body entry, leaving, reentry and changing eligibility while already inside. Resolve unsupported Falling explicitly: compare the source-specific sanctuary exception but do not silently extend it or turn the shell into a standing platform. State whether a living limb/reach attack can cross versus a released arrow, spell, air, light or sound. No invented damage, save, push or banishment follows from the name.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The actual concentration minute runs while local suppression can open a boundary; restoration may meet a real occupied body.
originalQuestions.options: A: define safe local restoration and occupancy, keeping original deadline and concentration. B: an explicit source-local ending rule for obstructed restoration.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose finite conflict handling without slicing, tactical ejection or relocating the source. Existing occupants, creatures temporarily carried across and transformed bodies must be adjudicable. Reuse ordinary expiry/placement rules and genuine source-specific exceptions only. Overlap gives no extra force or damage, and entry denial is not automatically a whole-Action hard-control application.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Abjuration:20-ft sphere suppresses ALL magic,range20feet. Universal:10-foot-RADIUS sphere suppresses magic,range10feet. Both Core durations are Instantaneous.
originalQuestions.options: A: preserve separate declared school modes with explicit geometry/lifetime. B: reconcile20-foot diameter with10-foot radius only through a justified source decision. C: union or silently choose whichever size is beneficial.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Reject silent C. A and B both need actual access: current classAccess schools are Abjuration even though Universal is a native printed placement. Preserve both rows and ranges. Choose fixed/moving center, clipping/line of effect, concentration and finite duration as NEW authorship; do not infer rank8 scales the accepted Lesser field’s numeric geometry or grants every school automatically.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Suppresses all magic needs actual magical-source classification, not all supernatural flavor or deletion of completed consequences.
originalQuestions.options: A: explicitly extend the accepted local-expression suppression contract to this distinct spell. B: author a different scoped suppression domain with exact reason.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer A where source-faithful. Include actual spells and explicitly magical nonspell techniques/items, source-protected exceptions, body-attached whole expressions versus area intersections, created bodies/animation, transformations, buffers, material changes, knowledge and remote concentration. Oracle Curse and Spell Preservation keep their intrinsic exceptions. Do not erase nonmagic RP pools, completed healing, injuries, permanent ordinary matter or historical resource payment.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Lesser Antimagic already has a same-family exemption and AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 termination-operation semantics; this rank8 identity is a different family.
originalQuestions.options: A: expressly define a shared no-oscillation relationship for these two field identities and any same-spell modes. B: a deterministic asymmetric priority or local suppression relationship with full state ordering.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: This needs an actual decision. A higher rank alone supplies no priority, and Lesser’s exemption currently names its own family only. State whether one can establish inside another, pay-first creation/counter timing, partial overlaps, concentration anchors, two independent sources and removal order. Distinguish same-field immunity to its own captured removal operation from a second field’s suppression; no recursive on/off oscillation or event-loop dependence.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Accepted Lesser input/output rules examine actual local manifestation, not imaginary paths; Globe recipient protection is a different source contract.
originalQuestions.options: A: explicitly extend relevant current manifestation and captured-operation handling. B: add an authored physical-path barrier with its own defined domain.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer A. Specify incoming/outgoing instantaneous effects, persistent external origins, teleport origins/endpoints, new creature/object placement, delayed/Ready release and genuine class Dispel classification. Outside-to-outside teleport does not cross an invented beam. Entry of a concentrating caster does not remotely suppress every owned effect. No new physical cover, pressure, ordinary attack wall or rank ceiling is printed.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Different summons and exile effects have source-specific suppression/return contracts; current pending spell packets are not permission to invent them.
originalQuestions.options: A: preserve each accepted source’s actual suppression lifecycle and require exact extensions for pending counterparts. B: globally despawn/recreate everything magical.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Use A. Keep original IDs, elapsed clocks, HP, spent commands/charges, gear ownership and carried bodies; no refresh, queued damage or duplicate creature on resumption. Actual ordinary Banishment and the two expressly bridged AC5 exiles close under their accepted rules only when their actual application is suppressed. Do not infer remote reach to a cell, broad terminal transport bypass, or a full cosmology from the field. Pending CompanionExact05, gate/glyph and planar packets remain comparison-only.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Abjuration protects against divination,psychic damage,mind-affecting SPELLS; Enchantment against psychic damage,mind reading,emotion manipulation; Universal against psychic damage,mind reading.
originalQuestions.options: A: preserve distinct source modes selected by actual school access. B: explicitly reconcile the descriptions into one justified common procedure. C: union all benefits with free access.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer A unless source evidence supports B; C is not automatic. All current class routes are Abjuration. Keep three native placements and exact wording, including spell versus nonspell distinctions. Select finite duration/concentration and willing/unwilling admission, since Core Instantaneous does not determine persistent immunity. Do not borrow a24-hour duration from another game or Alignment Immunity.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Immune to DIVINATION might bar direct targeting, acquired information about the bearer, or every result in which the bearer has any causal relevance.
originalQuestions.options: A: define protected recipient facts and direct/indirect acquisition paths. B: suppress any world observation even remotely involving the target.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose useful strong protection without making all history and ordinary senses unavailable. Resolve direct mind reading, location queries, remote scrying of a room containing the bearer, alignment queries, future predictions, information learned from another actual witness and already-known records. Decide what the spell may truthfully report when blocked; no fabricated answer, exact hidden immunity diagnosis or retroactive memory erasure. Protection from Scrying and accepted information contracts are exact comparisons, not blanket precedents.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Psychic damage immunity, mind-affecting spells, emotion manipulation and condition immunity are distinct mechanical scopes.
originalQuestions.options: A: source-specific component classification for each school mode. B: every Enchantment/Illusion effect or every condition is automatically prevented.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer A. A school label alone does not establish mind-affecting mechanics. Compare actual Dominate Person, Erase Emotion, Phantasmal Killer, Hypnotic Pattern, Greater Phantasmal Killer, mental-bomb, synaptic-static and physical/sensory illusions. Psychic damage may become0 while an independently allowed control component still has its own gate; conversely whole-effect mental immunity may prevent both where actually selected. Do not silently turn immunity to psychic damage into immunity to physical damage from a deceived actor’s ordinary weapon.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Existing mental effects, beneficial communication and the recipient’s own choices need explicit handling under broad immunity.
originalQuestions.options: A: define ongoing protected expressions versus new application prevention; retain independent histories. B: remove every prior mental-related effect and block all consent/communication.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose exact prevention/suppression/cure behavior separately. Clarify friendly telepathy, dream communication, willing emotion effects, self spells and voluntary bypass if any; they are not mind reading merely because mental. Keep languages, skills, personality and ordinary agency. If hard control is prevented initially, no guard expenditure; later suppression/end never refunds an already established guard, concentration loss or spent actions.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: AREA becomes IMPENETRABLE to those with NEGATIVE REPUTATION WITH YOUR FACTION. Range120feet and Instantaneous metadata give no area size/shape/lifetime.
originalQuestions.options: A: select an explicitly finite fixed ward volume/boundary with stated lifetime. B: enchant an existing bounded site or structure with an explicit maximum extent.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose actual geometry, anchor, line of effect, occupied-space admission, concentration if NEW and duration; the name does not conjure a stone fortress. Define whether all boundary surfaces are included and how existing openings/ground are treated. No unbounded city/faction network, arbitrary mobile wall or permanence follows from metadata.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Your faction and negative reputation use institutional standing, not alignment or enemies. Current standing map normally ranges−3..+3.
originalQuestions.options: A: select one actual qualifying faction of the caster at commitment and test each entrant’s current standing with it. B: snapshot entrant standings or combine multiple factions under an expressly authored rule.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose actual faction membership/affiliation qualification, multiple memberships, no faction and genuine missing entries. Negative ordinarily means below0, not simply nonpositive; decide how an uninitialized real record uses the established default without creating fabricated standing. Disguise, appearance, personal hostility and alignment do not substitute. Decide if later loss of caster membership affects an existing ward. This is a ward predicate, not approval of unseen faction/bestiary content.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Impenetrable TO THOSE with negative reputation could block bodies only or also their attacks, projectiles, spells and commanded agents.
originalQuestions.options: A: define body-entry exclusion with explicit transportation/carrying boundaries. B: extend to stated effect/attack channels using real origin/provenance.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose fully; do not borrow Wall of Force’s gas/sound/line-of-effect barrier or Globe’s rank filter. Address carried hostile bodies, eligible carriers with ineligible cargo, separate companions, released weapons, remote effects, teleport and bypass around finite edges. No unlimited guilt-by-association: a faction-neutral companion is not the caster’s body. Also do not weaken an agreed broader impenetrability clause by leaving obvious channel loopholes unresolved.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Reputation changes during a ward and suppression/resumption may change entry eligibility; current Reputation Shield prevents qualifying negative contributions, not facts or all hostile conduct.
originalQuestions.options: A: use the real current standing ledger at exact entry/occupation checkpoints with explicit treatment of occupants. B: freeze selected eligibility at creation for the ward’s lifetime.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose threshold timing and mid-operation change behavior. Preserve actual EX58/provenance/caps and Reputation Shield interactions, no artificial morality or forbidden standing decrease. Determine safe treatment of already-inside negative creatures, positive-to-negative changes, leaving/reentry, body growth, suppression crossing and restoration. No involuntary crushing/ejection, retroactive crime erasure, entry oracle disclosing exact scores or free reset by recasting.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Source preservation, a complete authored procedure, executable cases, runtime testing, playtesting and whole-game approval are separate gates.
originalQuestions.options: A: reuse exact accepted interfaces and add only explicitly agreed source-local rules. B: count source packaging or awareness delivery as semantic acceptance.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Use A. After decisions, build complete deterministic cases with actual access, numeric source ability/DC, prices/cadence, geometry/occupancy, identities, original clocks, suppression/interruption and final state. Include each native mode or explicitly inaccessible placement, all protected/unprotected channels and boundary values. Preserve all old questions and full counterparts. Pending Ward7/Illusion14/Companion10/rank8control are comparisons only; nothing in this packet accepts them or changes cosmology.
